title: 4BR Pet-Friendly 30A Vacation Rental on Duke Lake in Seagrove
meta_description: Relax at All's Well, a 4BR, 3BA pet-friendly 30A vacation rental on Dune Lake in Seagrove with lake views, boat, bicycles, and paddleboard access. Sleeps 15.
description_expanded: If fishing, crabbing, and relaxing at the beach are favorite activities for your vacation, All's Well is the ideal family getaway for you. Located on a beautiful Dune Lake in Seagrove Beach, this family house offers 4 bedrooms that sleep 15 with a large open living area. Enjoy expansive lake views from this elevated floor plan with open wooden decks across the back, and a 3rd floor outlook for Gulf views and sunsets.This lake place is just a short walk to white sand beaches and surf. Whether you fish from the dock or simply take in the peaceful activity of the lake and neighborhood beaches, All's Well should be your family's destination for your next vacation.To make your stay even more enjoyable, the home includes access to a paddle board, boat, and bicycles perfect for exploring the lake, cruising through the neighborhood, or heading to the beach in style.Your stay at All's Well comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 3 cars.* Pet Friendly: This property is pet friendly! If bringing a dog, please contact Reservations as an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. A maximum of 1 dog is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
